Who will Participate? This study will aggregately analyze, by region, the information provided by approximately 350 physicians across the US, EU, Japan, and China who accepted the invitation to participate, and who met all qualifying criteria. After reading through this information sheet, you will be asked whether you consent to participate in this study. What happens if I participate, decline participation? There is no benefit or risk to you by participating in this study, but the information collected will help to further the development of new oncology therapeutics and improve cancer treatment globally. If you decide to not participate, nothing will happen. If you choose to participate, you will be asked to complete an online survey about the treatment of your patients with HODGKIN LYMPHOMA (HL) or ACUTE LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA (ALL). This information will be anonymous; no information identifying you, or your patients, will be provided to the researchers. Participation is completely voluntary; you are free to end involvement with this study at any time, without providing a reason. We would like your permission to use your responses in the study, without revealing your personal information. Should you withdraw your consent for study participation, we will continue to use the data already collected from you as part of the study, unless you inform us in writing. For more information about your rights as participant, please see Oracle Life Sciences’ privacy policy and Terms and Conditions The study is for research purposes only and your answers will be confidential. This research is not intended as a promotional exercise. Your data will only be analyzed in combination with other physicians’ responses for reporting purposes. The research may be published in a scientific journal and may be included in reports submitted to regulatory agencies and other authorities. You will not be identified in any report or publication. All physicians fully completing this online survey will receive the incentive specified via invite for the time given to provide these answers. If you wish to participate in this study, it is your responsibility to seek approval from your practice manager as applicable. Confidentiality and study data This study is compliant with GDPR, and all international/local data protection legislations and Insights Association/ EphMRA/ BHBIA guidelines. The data collected will be transferred digitally to the U.S.A. and analyzed in aggregate, but never on an individual basis. We will make sure that it is kept secure at all times. Your information will only be used for research purposes and will not be passed to any other organization without your permission. We need your consent in order for us to collect and use any information about you. Who do I contact for further information and help? If you have questions, or a concern about any aspect of this study, you should ask to speak to the researchers who will do their best to answer your questions. They may be reached at paige.wagner@oracle.comcernerenviza.com or megan.epperson@oracle.comcernerenviza.com. CONSENT AND AUTHORIZATION By entering this survey link, I confirm that I have read and understand the information in this informed consent document and agree to participate in this study. I have had an opportunity to ask questions and all of my questions have been answered to my satisfaction. I voluntarily agree to participate in this study until I decide otherwise. I do not give up any of my legal rights consenting to participate in this study. Code Answer PN 1 I agree to participate 2 I do not agree to participate [PN: Terminate] Loi Bertrand and Anti- Cadeaux Disclosure [PN: Show in France only for HCP work] Concerning Market Research in France, according to French legislation Loi Bertrand and Loi Anti-Cadeaux, fieldwork agencies shall report all HCPs details partaking in this research on their centralized government website (https://www.entreprises-transparence.sante.gouv.fr & https://declaration-idahe2.ordre.medecin.fr/login.action Code Answer 1 Yes, I understand and agree to participate on this basis 2 No, I do not wish to participate [Terminate] Thank you for agreeing to participate in this survey. We are interested in your opinions about various HODGKIN LYMPHOMA (HL) or ACUTE LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA (ALL) related issues. We are interested in the treatment modalities that you utilize as well as systemic therapy regimens you use in specific situations. We would like you to restrict your answers to patients who you treat. Furthermore, we are interested in how you currently treat these patients. Please restrict your answers to patients who you have treated during the past 6 months, unless otherwise specified. Note to programmer: Do not show JF9

Who will Participate? This study will aggregately analyze, by region, the information provided by approximately 350 physicians across the US, EU, Japan, and China who accepted the invitation to participate, and who met all qualifying criteria. After reading through this information sheet, you will be asked whether you consent to participate in this study. What happens if I participate, decline participation? There is no benefit or risk to you by participating in this study, but the information collected will help to further the development of new oncology therapeutics and improve cancer treatment globally. If you decide to not participate, nothing will happen. If you choose to participate, you will be asked to complete an online survey about the treatment of your patients with HODGKIN LYMPHOMA (HL) or ACUTE LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA (ALL). This information will be anonymous; no information identifying you, or your patients, will be provided to the researchers. Participation is completely voluntary; you are free to end involvement with this study at any time, without providing a reason. We would like your permission to use your responses in the study, without revealing your personal information. Should you withdraw your consent for study participation, we will continue to use the data already collected from you as part of the study, unless you inform us in writing. For more information about your rights as participant, please see Oracle Life Sciences’ privacy policy and Terms and Conditions The study is for research purposes only and your answers will be confidential. This research is not intended as a promotional exercise. Your data will only be analyzed in combination with other physicians’ responses for reporting purposes. The research may be published in a scientific journal and may be included in reports submitted to regulatory agencies and other authorities. You will not be identified in any report or publication. All physicians fully completing this online survey will receive the incentive specified via invite for the time given to provide these answers. If you wish to participate in this study, it is your responsibility to seek approval from your practice manager as applicable. Confidentiality and study data This study is compliant with GDPR, and all international/local data protection legislations and Insights Association/ EphMRA/ BHBIA guidelines. The data collected will be transferred digitally to the U.S.A. and analyzed in aggregate, but never on an individual basis. We will make sure that it is kept secure at all times. Your information will only be used for research purposes and will not be passed to any other organization without your permission. We need your consent in order for us to collect and use any information about you. Who do I contact for further information and help? If you have questions, or a concern about any aspect of this study, you should ask to speak to the researchers who will do their best to answer your questions. They may be reached at paige.wagner@oracle.comcernerenviza.com or megan.epperson@oracle.comcernerenviza.com. CONSENT AND AUTHORIZATION By entering this survey link, I confirm that I have read and understand the information in this informed consent document and agree to participate in this study. Who will Participate? This study will aggregately analyze, by region, the information provided by approximately 350 physicians across the US, EU, Japan, and China who accepted the invitation to participate, and who met all qualifying criteria. After reading through this information sheet, you will be asked whether you consent to participate in this study. What happens if I participate, decline participation? There is no benefit or risk to you by participating in this study, but the information collected will help to further the development of new oncology therapeutics and improve cancer treatment globally. If you decide to not participate, nothing will happen. If you choose to participate, you will be asked to complete an online survey about the treatment of your patients with HODGKIN LYMPHOMA (HL) or ACUTE LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA (ALL). This information will be anonymous; no information identifying you, or your patients, will be provided to the researchers. Participation is completely voluntary; you are free to end involvement with this study at any time, without providing a reason. We would like your permission to use your responses in the study, without revealing your personal information. Should you withdraw your consent for study participation, we will continue to use the data already collected from you as part of the study, unless you inform us in writing. For more information about your rights as participant, please see Oracle Life Sciences’ privacy policy and Terms and Conditions The study is for research purposes only and your answers will be confidential. This research is not intended as a promotional exercise. Your data will only be analyzed in combination with other physicians’ responses for reporting purposes. The research may be published in a scientific journal and may be included in reports submitted to regulatory agencies and other authorities. You will not be identified in any report or publication. All physicians fully completing this online survey will receive the incentive specified via invite for the time given to provide these answers. If you wish to participate in this study, it is your responsibility to seek approval from your practice manager as applicable. Confidentiality and study data This study is compliant with GDPR, and all international/local data protection legislations and Insights Association/ EphMRA/ BHBIA guidelines. The data collected will be transferred digitally to the U.S.A. and analyzed in aggregate, but never on an individual basis. We will make sure that it is kept secure at all times. Your information will only be used for research purposes and will not be passed to any other organization without your permission. We need your consent in order for us to collect and use any information about you. Who do I contact for further information and help? If you have questions, or a concern about any aspect of this study, you should ask to speak to the researchers who will do their best to answer your questions. They may be reached at paige.wagner@oracle.comcernerenviza.com or megan.epperson@oracle.comcernerenviza.com. Introduction
This is a syndicated study sponsored by Oracle Life Sciences, an independent research organization, and is designed to better understand standard treatment practices of different types of cancer in different geographies.
Who will Participate?
This study will aggregately analyze, by region, the information provided by approximately 350 physicians across the US, EU, Japan, and China who accepted the invitation to participate, and who met all qualifying criteria. After reading through this information sheet, you will be asked whether you consent to participate in this study.
What happens if I participate, decline participation?
There is no benefit or risk to you by participating in this study, but the information collected will help to further the development of new oncology therapeutics and improve cancer treatment globally.
If you decide to not participate, nothing will happen. If you choose to participate, you will be asked to complete an online survey about the treatment of your patients with HODGKIN LYMPHOMA (HL) or ACUTE LYMPHOCYTIC LEUKEMIA (ALL). This information will be anonymous; no information identifying you, or your patients, will be provided to the researchers.
Participation is completely voluntary; you are free to end involvement with this study at any time, without providing a reason. We would like your permission to use your responses in the study, without revealing your personal information. Should you withdraw your consent for study participation, we will continue to use the data already collected from you as part of the study, unless you inform us in writing. For more information about your rights as participant, please see Oracle Life Sciences’ privacy policy and Terms and Conditions
The study is for research purposes only and your answers will be confidential. This research is not intended as a promotional exercise. Your data will only be analyzed in combination with other physicians’ responses for reporting purposes.
The research may be published in a scientific journal and may be included in reports submitted to regulatory agencies and other authorities. You will not be identified in any report or publication.
All physicians fully completing this online survey will receive the incentive specified via invite for the time given to provide these answers.
If you wish to participate in this study, it is your responsibility to seek approval from your practice manager as applicable.
Confidentiality and study data
This study is compliant with GDPR, and all international/local data protection legislations and Insights Association/ EphMRA/ BHBIA guidelines.
The data collected will be transferred digitally to the U.S.A. and analyzed in aggregate, but never on an individual basis. We will make sure that it is kept secure at all times.
Your information will only be used for research purposes and will not be passed to any other organization without your permission. We need your consent in order for us to collect and use any information about you.
Who do I contact for further information and help?
If you have questions, or a concern about any aspect of this study, you should ask to speak to the researchers who will do their best to answer your questions. They may be reached at paige.wagner@oracle.comcernerenviza.com or megan.epperson@oracle.comcernerenviza.com.
CONSENT AND AUTHORIZATION
By entering this survey link, I confirm that I have read and understand the information in this informed consent document and agree to participate in this study. I have had an opportunity to ask questions and all of my questions have been answered to my satisfaction. I voluntarily agree to participate in this study until I decide otherwise. I do not give up any of my legal rights consenting to participate in this study.
